name.value: Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Langley-Surrey

description.value: Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Langley-Surrey is a four-storey branded hotel on the Langley Bypass near the Surrey-Langley municipal boundary. Part of the Hilton portfolio, it offers mid-scale accommodation with consistent brand standards in a highway-adjacent setting. Its location makes it a practical overnight stop for cyclists travelling the Fraser Valley corridor.
